This move will bolster the company's financial standing. Additionally, Jignesh Devchandbhai Rathod has been appointed as Whole-Time Director and CEO. These approvals were confirmed through a remote e-voting process.

title: US stocks: Dow hits record high on Iran deal optimism, lower oil prices
description: Major Wall Street indexes surged at the open on Monday following a preliminary agreement between Washington and Tehran to resolve the Middle East conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. This development triggered a significant drop in crude oil prices, boosting investor confidence across the board.

title: NSE Indices launch 11 new sectoral indices including Nifty Power and Nifty Hospitals
description: NSE Indices has introduced 11 new sectoral benchmarks, taking its total sectoral index count to 34. The move aims to deepen sector-specific market coverage, support the growing passive investment ecosystem and provide fund managers with new benchmarks for ETFs, index funds and thematic products.

title: US stocks: Aerospace parts maker Doncasters targets $4.4 billion valuation in US IPO
description: Aerospace innovator Doncasters is gearing up for a high-stakes debut in the U.S. public market, targeting an impressive $746.7 million by offering shares priced between $28 and $32. This strategic initiative comes on the heels of a thriving U.S. IPO scene that has been flourishing since April.
